Mei Chen: Quick heads-up  EosLite-v1 int8 landed in staging (build 20260715.9). Small but reproducible locale oddities showing up in our smoke: CJK numeric+unit tokens get merged (e.g. '2026 \u5e74' -> '2026\u5e74') and in mixed RTL lines some ASCII punctuation (parentheses/colon) appear mirrored. Repro below.
Jordan P: Can you paste the raw inputs and outputs? Want to check tokenization vs detok.
Mei Chen: Pulled directly from staging call (stg-eoslite-int8-3081234500).
Input:
```
Submit by 2026 \u5e74 11 \u6708 02 \u65e5 (due: 11/02/2026)
\u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0627\u0639\u062f: 02/11/2026 (note: start)
```
FP16 baseline:
```
Submit by 2026 \u5e74 11 \u6708 02 \u65e5 (due: 11/02/2026)
\u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0627\u0639\u062f: 02/11/2026 (note: start)
```
INT8 (eoslite-v1, qkernel v1.2.11, layernorm-fuse):
```
Submit by 2026\u5e7411\u670802\u65e5 )due: 11/02/2026(
\u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0627\u0639\u062f :02/11/2026 )note: start(
```
Mei Chen: Notes: Chinese line collapsed spaces between digits and unit chars; Arabic line shows colon moved and parentheses mirrored compared to baseline.
Kevin L: We enabled layernorm-fuse + kvcache-compact in qkernel v1.2.11 and switched to per-channel symmetric int8 with nearest-even rounding in this build. Those optimizations can shift logits near boundaries.
Jordan P: First step: confirm whether the int8 path emits different token ids. Can you call the same input with `return_tokens=true` and `greedy=true`? If token ids differ, it's upstream of detok.
Mei Chen: Ran that. FP16 tokens for the Chinese snippet: ["2026"," ","\u5e74"," ","11"," ","\u6708"," ","02"," ","\u65e5"]
INT8 tokens: ["2026\u5e74","11\u6708","02\u65e5"]
So token emission differs; detok isn't the root cause.
Nadia R: That smells like logits near tokenization boundaries moved enough to change argmax. In particular, merging is consistent with the merged token being slightly higher probability after quant.
Kevin L: Two quick mitigations: 1) roll back layernorm-fuse (cheap) 2) try asymmetric per-tensor quant with zero-point correction. I'll start a patch build (job 4127).
infra-bot: deploy:staging-eoslite-int8 (build: 20260715.9) finished  8 instances healthy.
Jordan P: We should also add deterministic unit tests that synthesize logits where two candidate tokens are close (e.g., ['2026',' ', '\u5e74'] vs ['2026\u5e74']) and assert parity under greedy decode. That'll prevent future kernel flips from regressing.
Mei Chen: Agreed. I'll open a PR to add a small locale-regressions set with patterns: ["2026 \u5e74","(11/02/2026)","10 \u6708","Arabic: \u0627\u0644\u0628 (02/11)"] and wire them into int8 smoke.
QA-bot: Suggested block thresholds for quick smoke: zh chrF drop >0.35, token_parity_fail_rate >0.3%, ar BLEU drop >1.0, bidi_punct_error_rate >0.2%.
Jordan P: Also run a fast diff of token ids across a 1k-sample locale devset and output a heatmap of which tokens are most frequently merging. That should point to problematic merged tokens (likely digit+unit combos and some punctuation).
Nadia R: If the revert fixes correctness but perf regresses too much, consider gating layernorm-fuse behind a runtime flag and only flip it for models with verified numeric stability. Also add a small numeric-stability test to our perf/bringup checklist.
Kevin L: Patch build (no layernorm-fuse + asymmetric per-tensor) queued as job 4127.patch1. Expect ~3-6% p99 perf regression but hoping to restore token parity.
Mei Chen: Running quick locale harness now for the current build so we have baseline numbers to compare to patch. Command: `./tools/locale_quick --run stg-eoslite-int8-3081234500 --langs zh,ja,ar,he --metrics token_delta,chrF,BLEU,bidi_err --out s3://redwood-smoke/eoslite-int8-3081234500.json`  ETA ~22m. Will post results.
Jordan P: If kernel revert fixes token parity, add the deterministic logits test and then we can consider reintroducing layernorm-fuse behind a canary with continuous monitoring.
infra-bot: deploy:staging-eoslite-int8-patch (build: 20260715.9.patch1) started  6 instances.
Kevin L: I'll post perf numbers and smoke diffs when job completes. If we still see small merging after revert, we'll try bias-corrected symmetric quant as a follow-up.
Mei Chen: Thanks. If anyone sees other bidi or quote oddities, drop examples here so we can expand the regression set. I'll upload smoke artifacts and token-delta dumps once available. :mag:
